mentions.name: Deep Equilibrium Model Poisson VAE
mentions.description: This project applies a deep equilibrium model using a recurrent neural network as the inference encoder within a Poisson variational autoencoder, with work focused on evaluating and documenting the approach.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on evaluating and documenting my application of a deep equilibrium model with a recurrent neural network as an inference encoder in a Poisson variational autoencoder.
